children: Kosmos Energy Ltd. (KOS) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 08, 2026.

On September 8, 2026, Kosmos Energy Ltd. (the "Company") will issue a notice of partial redemption with respect to $25,000,000 aggregate principal amount of its 7.750% senior notes due 2027 (the "Notes"). Redemption of the Notes is expected to occur on September 18, 2026. The Company may elect to pursue one or more additional optional redemptions prior to the final maturity date of the Notes.
This Current Report on Form 8-K does not constitute a notice of redemption with respect to the Notes.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1509991/000150999126000051/kos-20260908.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1509991/000150999126000051/0001509991-26-000051-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
